# 🦸 Superpowers for your workflows - Create a plugin 100% generated by AI

> Slides from a talk by **François Delbrayelle**, Lead Software Engineer @ Kestra
> — [github.com/fdelbrayelle](https://github.com/fdelbrayelle) · [linkedin.com/in/fdelbrayelle](https://linkedin.com/in/fdelbrayelle)

---

## What is a workflow?

A workflow is the **fundamental unit of orchestration**. It defines a set of tasks, their execution order, inputs, outputs, and orchestration logic.

## What is orchestration?

- Connect disparate systems
- Extract, transform and load data at scale
- Manage autonomous agents

> Modern orchestration is broken — complexity grows, pipelines fail silently, errors cascade.

---

## What is Kestra?

[Kestra](https://kestra.io) is an open-source workflow orchestration platform.

| Edition | Description |
|---|---|
| Open-source core | Orchestration Logic, Business Logic in any language, Event Driven Execution Engine, Control Plane |
| Enterprise Edition | Security, Governance, Scalability, Guaranteed Support & SLA, Customer Success & Trainings |
| Kestra Cloud | Fully managed |
| Plugins & Ecosystem | 1400+ plugins for every integration |

### By the numbers

- **10 000+** Organizations
- **2 Billion** Flows executed in 2025
- **27 000** GitHub Stars — [kestra-io/kestra](https://github.com/kestra-io/kestra)
- **1 300+** OSS contributors

### Why Kestra is so unique?

- **Unified Interface** — one place for all your workflows
- **Declarative & Agnostic** — define flows in YAML, run any language
- **Event-Driven** — react to any event, internal or external
- **High Scale** — Run anything, anywhere

## What is a plugin?

> *Plugins power every task and trigger in Kestra. They wrap external systems, expose orchestration primitives, and let you extend the platform with custom code.*

- 10% most used plugins by 90% of the users
- **1400+ plugins** available at [kestra.io/plugins](https://kestra.io/plugins)
- Everything is a plugin

---

## AI Maturity Level

| Level | Label | Decision Maker | Characteristic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **L5b** | Self-Authoring | AI creates new agents | Writes, tests, and deploys agent roles |
| **L5a** | Self-Optimizing | AI updates instructions | Updates prompts / orchestration logic |
| **L4b** | Autonomous | AI, unsupervised | Same as L4a but no human gate |
| **→ L4a** | **Supervised Agentic** | **AI, human bounds** | **Dynamic next-steps; multi-agent; gates** |
| L3 | Scripted | Human designed flow | Deterministic; fixed step order |
| L2 | Augmented | Human, AI suggestions | Copilot, autocomplete, basic API calls |
| L1 | Manual | Human, every time | Prompts typed into web UI; no integration |

This project operates at **L4a — Supervised Agentic**: AI drives the implementation with a software engineer in the loop for review and approval gates.

---

## Software Engineer in the loop

The workflow for AI-generated plugin development:

1. 👨‍💻 Engineer **writes the issue**
2. 🤖 AI runs `/kestra-plugin-plan` — generates implementation plan
3. 👨‍💻 Engineer runs `/plan-approved` — reviews and approves the plan
4. 🤖 AI runs `/kestra-plugin-issue` — acts as both **developer** and **reviewer**
5. 👨‍💻 Engineer **reviews, merges and releases**

The context fed to the AI agents is **3000 lines of markdown** covering Kestra plugin conventions, APIs, and best practices.

| Total output tokens | ~36,000 |

| Developer agent + QA share | ~70% of total input tokens |
